name: Slider Puzzle
summary:
Slider Puzzle transforms the beloved sliding tile challenge into an immersive VR experience like no other. It’s more than just solving puzzles—it’s about building your world one move at a time.

Start with a quiet, minimal space. Solve a puzzle—and watch as your environment begins to unfold. Every level you complete reveals a new piece of the stylized low-poly world around you, turning each success into a moment of visual discovery.
